title: Canonical proper-support pullback map
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring. Let
$$X'\xrightarrow{a}X,\; f'\downarrow,\; f\downarrow,\; Y'\xrightarrow{b}Y$$
be a Cartesian square of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-fibre-product], with $f$ separated and locally of finite type [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Let $F$ be a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Use direct image and constant-coefficient inverse image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact]. Suppose $G\subseteq f_*F$ and $H\subseteq f'_*a^{-1}F$ are subsheaves with the following section descriptions. For every etale $U\to Y$, $G(U)$ consists of the sections of $F(X\times_YU)$ whose closed support is proper over $U$; for every etale $V\to Y'$, $H(V)$ consists of the sections of $(a^{-1}F)(X'\times_{Y'}V)$ whose closed support is proper over $V$. Here support is the locus of nonzero geometric germs [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks], and a closed subset is proper over its base if its reduced induced closed subscheme is proper [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base].
There is a canonical $\Lambda$-linear sheaf morphism $\alpha:G\to b_*H$, natural in $F$, whose component on each etale $U\to Y$ sends $s\in G(U)$ to its unit pullback on
$$X'\times_{Y'}(U\times_YY')\cong(X\times_YU)\times_YY'.$$
The support of this image section is exactly the inverse image of $\operatorname{Supp}(s)$ under the displayed projection to $X\times_YU$.
